note: Issue 442, patrons.md sections 3 and 4, policy.md sections 3 and 8. A patron whose livestock specialty was rolled with the other bonus - faster breeding - offers it once he thinks well enough of the PC and a pasture or town pasture stands somewhere in the colony. Accepted, it is a policy: every herd of his kind breeds faster, in every town. The PC answers with a share of its charge, all, half or none; a policy of his still standing when he sails is the colony's for good. 90 a month is a placeholder. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I breed {param:resource}, and I breed them better than anybody I know, which I say because it is true and not because it is modest.
I could send you my stockmen and a few of my best. Every herd of {param:resource} in your colony would come on faster for it, in every town that keeps them.
The men would want their keep while they are about it. I should like the Crown to meet that.
The men would want their keep. I say so now so that you cannot say later I did not.

options.label: accept, and the Crown bears the charge
options.text: Send them, and let the Crown bear the whole of the charge. I would not have you out of pocket for a kindness to my colony.

options.label: accept, and the Crown bears half
options.text: Send them, and the Crown will meet half the charge. I will not pretend that is generous.

options.label: accept, and leave the charge to him
options.text: Send them, and I must leave their keep with you. The Crown has nothing to put towards it this year, and I would rather say so than pretend.

options.label: decline, with thanks
options.text: I must decline, and I am sorry to. The Crown has no room for another charge this year.
